title: Index
description: A global metadata catalog for the Major TOM 10 km grid, with one row per tile covering 5,055,204 tiles aligned to the Sentinel-2 MGRS grid between 80°S and 84°N. Each tile is enriched with terrain, climate, soil, socioeconomic, and administrative attributes from public Earth Engine datasets, plus per-sensor variants linking tiles to Sentinel-2 and Landsat 8/9 imagery for Earth observation foundation-model research.

readme: ## README.md # Major TOM Index [![Source Cooperative](https://img.shields.io/badge/Source_Cooperative-majortom--index-blue)](https://source.coop/major-tom/index) [![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-CC--BY--4.0-orange)](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/) Global metadata catalog for the Major TOM 10 km grid. One row per tile, **5,055,204 tiles** between 80°S and 84°N. ``` https://data.source.coop/major-tom/index/global.parquet ``` GeoParquet 1.1.0 · 174 MB · ZSTD · sorted by `majortom:code_1000km` → `majortom:code_100km` → `id` ## Schema | Column | Type | Description | |---|---|---| | `id` | `string` | Major TOM 10 km grid cell identifier, format MT{dist}km_{row:04d}{U\|D}_{col:04d}{R\|L} | | `majortom:code_100km` | `string` | Parent 100 km grid cell identifier | | `majortom:code_1000km` | `string` | Parent 1000 km grid cell identifier | | `majortom:crs` | `string` | Native UTM CRS of the assigned MGRS tile | | `majortom:mgrs_tile` | `string` | Assigned Sentinel-2 MGRS tile identifier | | `majortom:geotransform` | `list` | MGRS-snapped affine geotransform [x0, 10, 0, y0, 0, -10] | | `majortom:geotransform_raw` | `list` | Nominal affine geotransform from the centroid, before the MGRS snap | | `geoenrich:elevation` | `float` | Elevation in metres (Copernicus GLO-30 DEM) | | `geoenrich:cisi` | `float` | Critical Infrastructure Spatial Index, 0 to 1 (Nirandjan et al. 2022) | | `geoenrich:precipitation` | `float` | Mean annual precipitation in mm per year (ERA5, 1979 to 2020) | | `geoenrich:temperature` | `float` | Mean annual 2 m air temperature in degrees Celsius (ERA5, 1979 to 2020) | | `geoenrich:soil_clay` | `float` | Clay content at 0 cm depth in percent by weight (OpenLandMap) | | `geoenrich:soil_sand` | `float` | Sand content at 0 cm depth in percent by weight (OpenLandMap) | | `geoenrich:soil_carbon` | `float` | Soil organic carbon at 0 cm depth in g/kg (OpenLandMap) | | `geoenrich:soil_bulk_density` | `float` | Fine earth bulk density at 0 cm depth in kg/m3 (OpenLandMap) | | `geoenrich:soil_ph` | `float` | Soil pH in water at 0 cm depth (OpenLandMap) | | `geoenrich:gdp` | `float` | Total GDP for 2022 in 2017 international dollars, PPP (Kummu et al. 2025) | | `geoenrich:human_modification` | `float` | Human modification index for 2020, 0 to 1 (GHM v3, Theobald et al. 2025) | | `geoenrich:population` | `float` | Population density in people per km2, 0 over water and Antarctica (GPW v4.11, 2020) | | `geoenrich:admin_countries` | `string` | Country name at the centroid, or Ocean/Sea/Lakes | | `geoenrich:admin_states` | `string` | State or province name at the centroid | | `geoenrich:admin_districts` | `string` | District or county name at the centroid | | `geometry` | `binary` | Tile centroid as a WKB Point in EPSG:4326 | Every `geoenrich:` value is sampled at the tile centroid at 5120 m scale, not averaged over the tile. `null` means the source has no data at that point, not zero. The exception is `geoenrich:population`, which is 0 over water and Antarctica because nobody lives there. ## Quick start ```python import duckdb duckdb.sql(""" INSTALL httpfs; LOAD httpfs; SELECT "geoenrich:admin_countries" AS country, COUNT(*) AS tiles FROM 'https://data.source.coop/major-tom/index/global.parquet' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10 """).show() ``` ## Other files Per-sensor subsets and the ELLIOT sample live in [`extra/`](extra/). ## Citation ```bibtex @inproceedings{Francis2024MajorTOM, author = {Francis, Alistair and Czerkawski, Mikolaj}, title = {Major TOM: Expandable Datasets for Earth Observation}, booktitle = {IGARSS 2024 - IEEE International Geoscience and Remote Sensing Symposium}, year = {2024}, pages = {2935--2940}, doi = {10.1109/IGARSS53475.2024.10640760} } ``` ## License CC-BY-4.0 ## Acknowledgements The Major TOM Index has been made possible thanks to [Asterisk Labs](https://asterisk.coop), the [ELLIOT](https://elliot-earth.eu) project (European Commission, Horizon Europe, Grant 101214398), and the [Image and Signal Processing Group (ISP)](https://isp.uv.es) at Universitat de València.
